english.title: Election officer or clerk act as candidates agent
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[a returning officer at a parliamentary election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..),]_
(B)_[a returning officer at a local government election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..),]_
(C)_[an officer or clerk appointed under the parliamentary elections rules, or the rules under section 36 or section 42 of the Representation of the People Act 1983,]_
(D)_[a partner or clerk of an officer or clerk appointed under the parliamentary elections rules, or the rules under section 36 or section 42 of the Representation of the People Act 1983,]_

acted as an agent of a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..), in the conduct or management of

(E)_[that election]_
(F)_[an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 99(1) and (2) of the Representation of the People Act 1983.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex see section 176Note
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
